record.one_liner: Google's API for programmatic management, reporting and ad management of Google Ads accounts and campaigns.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 user flow plus service account flow (graded as other); every call also needs a 22-character developer token sent in the developer-token header (api_key). login-customer-id header needed for manager accounts.
record.access_notes: Enabling the API gives Test access (test accounts only) automatically; production accounts need an Explorer/Basic/Standard access-level application on the Google Ads API Overview page. critic: confirmed approval_required.
record.api_notes: Docs describe the REST interface alongside gRPC client libraries; no GraphQL. Covers campaigns, ad groups, assets, labels and GAQL reporting.
record.blocker_notes: Test access works for test accounts immediately; production use needs an access-level application (Explorer/Basic/Standard). critic: confirmed. MCP is documented on Google's developer docs and hosted in the googleads GitHub org.

evidence.quote: Both OAuth 2.0 user authentication flow and service account flow are supported.
A developer token is required in the developer-token HTTP header for every API call.
apply for Explorer access on the Google Ads API Overview page to access production accounts
Enable Google Ads API in your Google Cloud project to automatically be granted Test access for your project.
Google may automatically upgrade your project's API access level to Explorer after you submit your application.
The Google Ads MCP server provides a standardized bridge to the Google Ads API.
